thread:
Anika (arch): thinking about a migration pattern — 'shadow mode' — mirror production requests to the new v2 inference endpoint but don't route responses back to clients. want to discuss tradeoffs vs a shim/proxy approach. cc @Chris @Sam
Chris (eng-platform): interesting. is the idea full traffic mirror or sampled? where does duplication happen — ingress proxy or gateway? what's the latency profile?
Anika (arch): plan is sampled mirroring at the edge proxy, async duplication so no request path blocking. Mirror writes to a best-effort publisher that feeds offline comparator. Key goals: validate functional parity, safety regressions, and perf delta without affecting customers.
Sam (eng-runtime): runtime concerns: KV cache semantics and tokenization differences. mirroring could behave differently if v2 changes tokenization or cache keys — might produce misleading comparisons. also streaming vs request/response differences.
Maya (eng-sre): must be async. sync mirroring = tail-latency risk. also add per-tenant opt-in + circuit-breaker. Ops needs clear metrics and an automatic disable if shadow path causes errors.
Ben (product): PII is a blocker for many customers. mirrored payloads must be sanitized or explicitly disallowed for regulated tenants. also need product sign-off to run any mirror on prod-level data.
Anika (arch): agreed on scrub step. early config sketch:
```yaml
shadow:
  enabled: true
  mode: async  # async vs sync (sync = DO NOT USE in prod)
  scrub: basic  # none | basic | strict (PII redaction)
  sample_rate: 0.01  # fraction of requests to mirror
  tag: shadow_v2
```
Chris (eng-platform): add headers `X-Shadow-Mode: v2` and `X-Shadow-Sample: true` for traceability. telemetry: `shadow.latency`, `shadow.error`, `shadow.mismatch` metrics. keep mapping request_id -> shadow_id for debugging.
Sam (eng-runtime): streaming streams are tricky — proposal: do not mirror WS/streaming clients initially. only mirror REST/gRPC generation calls where request/response is bounded. for streaming we need frame-level mapping and that explodes complexity.
Anika (arch): good call. start with non-streamed endpoints. also we must avoid polluting runtime caches: mirrored requests should be annotated so the runtime skips cache writes or uses a separate shadow cache namespace.
Maya (eng-sre): ops runbook (brief): 1) enable sample_rate 0.1% for a developer tenant; 2) observe `shadow.latency` and `shadow.error` for 48h; 3) run comparator job to compute output drift and safety alerts; 4) if regressions > threshold -> disable.
lena (sec): PII/compliance: scrub heuristics are not sufficient for some customers. default to OFF for enterprise/reg tenants. require explicit approval and an auditable config change. log access to shadow data via KMS/HSM-backed keys and restrict retention.
Ben (product): comparator should produce a prioritized list of testcases where v2 diverges meaningfully, and labels for safety regressions vs quality deltas. product wants a dashboard slice per-tenant.
Chris (eng-platform): retention: shadow responses stored compressed, retention cap 30d by default, configurable per-tenant. add quota accounting so large tenants don't blow storage.
Sam (eng-runtime): API we need in runtime: `mirror_publish(req, meta)` which serializes a normalized request + response to a topic. also runtime flag to `skip_cache_on_shadow=true` so mirrors don't contaminate caches.
Anika (arch): comparator job will need the original request, v1 response (prod), and v2 response (shadow). offline comparators compute metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-ish, hallucination signals, safety classifiers). telemetry should tag by `shadow.cohort` and `shadow.tenant`.
Maya (eng-sre): sample vs full mirror — prefer sample initially. also include a heatmap of sequence length and tokens so we pick tenants that represent realistic load.
Chris (eng-platform): add header-based opt-in for dev tenants: if `X-Shadow-Opt-in: true` present, we mirror at 100% for that header — useful for test tenants.
Anika (arch): rollback policy: comparator posts regression -> automation can flip `shadow.enabled=false` for affected cohorts. also notify owners and create a rollout incident if needed. suggest `shadow.fail_fast_on_regression: true` option.
lena (sec): put a gating rule: any tenant with `compliance: strict` cannot be mirrored. add audit trail for who enabled shadow and when.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for shadow-proxy PoC, build ci-7789 (canary) :rocket:
Chris (eng-platform): implementation notes: place mirroring at envoy filter or internal gateway filter? Envoy filter reduces app work but makes scrubbing harder. gateway filter lets us reuse existing auth/scrub code.
Sam (eng-runtime): for prototype I'll implement `mirror_publish` in runtime. need schema for mirrored envelope: request_id, tenant_id, headers, scrubbed_payload, model_params, v2_response, metadata.
Anika (arch): final action items: 1) Chris: architect the edge/gateway placement and header contract (this week). 2) Sam: runtime `mirror_publish` + skip-cache option (next sprint). 3) Maya: ops runbook + alert thresholds (this week). 4) lena: compliance checklist + approval flow (this week). 5) Ben: comparator requirements and dashboard fields (this week). I'll draft a short RFC and link it back here.
Ben (product): timeline ask: pilot for low-risk tenants within 3 weeks?
Anika (arch): aim for PoC canary in 2 weeks, pilot after validation.
Maya (eng-sre): small ask: include a metric for mirror amplification (ratio of mirrored to original) so we can monitor cost.
Chris (eng-platform): noted. will include `shadow.amplification` and cost tags.
Anika (arch): thanks everyone — I'll post the RFC draft in ~1h. follow-ups on design decisions in new thread.
